scope: Approved full196 primary host analysis; no biological pilot
gene_key: assembly|replicon|locus_tag; source protein accessions retained separately
multicopy_rule: Two or more qualifying distinct loci for a marker in a genome are missing/flagged, without arbitrary best-hit selection
length_filter: GToTree +/-20 percent of marker median protein length after multicopy exclusion, with exact source proteins and exclusions retained
post_occupancy_recovery_denominator: Primary retained marker count; this additional gate follows, and never replaces, the initial96/119 requirement
failed_genome_rule: Report scientific blocker; never prune or replace an approved assembly
primary_marker_order: Sorted profile NAME identifiers from the pinned HMM, after frozen occupancy filtering
alignment: Stage3 uses the actual GToTree1.8.10 serial amino-acid extraction helper with HMMER GA cutoffs and preserved full evidence; Stage4 aligns accepted markers with MAFFT --auto --thread 2 and trimAl -automated1. Concatenation is rebuilt in frozen marker order, with no synthetic spacer residues.

iqtree.model_selection: MFP separately across edge-proportional marker partitions without partition merging
iqtree.rationale: Partition-specific protein substitution models while bounding ModelFinder resource use
iqtree.memory_limit: Set from measured free RAM with Windows headroom before execution
iqtree.root_policy: Explicitly unrooted unless separately retrieved and validated outgroups justify a root

sensitivity_scopes: Preserved G0 exact162 list as a separate sensitivity
Markers accepted in at least187/196 genomes (95 percent occupancy)
Approved primary assemblies reported Complete Genome or Chromosome in the frozen metadata
evidence_limit: Predeclared methods. No marker search, alignment or topology result is claimed by this configuration.
configuration_revision: stage03-v1 frozen before marker search; stage02 original config remains historical payload
